youtube_description:
Learn how to move your scenes and sources to OBS Studio from Streamlabs OBS. This allows you to have your streaming scenes moved and available within OBS Studio, in just a few clicks! 

Moving your themes and scenes to OBS Studio from SLOBS is really easy and takes probably no more than two minutes. You then simply need to configure your mic and cam, and you're ready to roll with OBS Studio in no time! 

There are many pros and cons to OBS Studio, as well as SLOBS, but it's really great that movement between the two is relatively easy to do with your scenes and sources.

In the video I also show how you can port over multiple scene collections and themes at once, so you do not just import / export the 'active' scene. 

This same process can also be used to move over the themes that are available on Streamlabs Prime from their Theme and Widget store, for use in OBS Studio. 

Default OBS Studio location for scenes is; C:\Users\[USERNAME]\AppData\Roaming\obs-studio\basic\scenes
Default SLOBS location for scenes is; C:\Users\[USERNAME]\AppData\Roaming\slobs-client\SceneCollections
